scope: Native SyscallResponse backing ownership for an actual-method runner

findings.finding: Memory::new copies OsToken, extents and layout into Arc<Memory> but owns neither original pages nor BootStorage. OsToken::test_only and BootLayout::select validate metadata and do not grant a live lease or backing authority.
findings.consequence: A runner allocation plus copied metadata cannot satisfy Memory::new's unsafe started-BootStorage and original-owner precondition.

findings.finding: The production lifetime graph uses PageOwner allocation/drop, complete mapping coverage, ownership assignment, started BootStorage and a continuing Arc<Memory>. Setting started in a fixture would fabricate rather than exercise that authority.

Memory::syscall performs real mapping/generation/conflict checks and inserts the private serial-tagged response. Completion publication and SyscallResponse::release remove exact ledger entries, while unfinished failures quarantine them. Claim is Copy metadata derived afterward and is not lease authority.

A fixture can wrap runner memory and leave a private response tag after preparation failure while dropping the backing guard. Arc<Memory> cannot prevent this because it owns no backing; adding backing to that Arc still needs an independent quarantine owner after the last response drops.

required_architecture_decision.capability: An opaque retained-backing capability whose factory establishes allocation coverage, generation authority and exclusive admission and whose lifetime survives outstanding responses and quarantined tags.
alternatives: A test-only adapter that consumes an already established native owner graph and therefore requires separately authorized native setup.
A test-only owned allocation/generation model that permits real Memory::syscall ledger-method testing but explicitly excludes native BootStorage and lease ownership proof.
invariants: Expose only a scoped runner/report interface within the existing memory/service visibility boundary.
Reject wrong generation, uncovered or misaligned spans, overlapping claims, invalid initial atomics and premature teardown.
Demonstrate quarantine after preparation failure and exact release/reuse after publication.
Preserve application-owner-lock before memory-ledger lock ordering and never reenter either lock from hooks.

disposition: The generic actual-method prerequisite remains viable, but no complete native implementation packet or write allowlist is released until one authority alternative is selected, specified and independently reviewed.
